## Watchdog

Checks the org is actually working, continuously.

**Two tiers, on purpose.** The shallow check runs every 15 minutes and costs nothing — it asks the n8n API which workflows are active and whether anything errored. The deep probe runs once a day and actually calls the teams end to end.

The split matters: a deep probe every 15 minutes would run three GPT-4o agents 96 times a day purely to check they still answer. That bill would dwarf the actual work.

**Needs an n8n API key** — Settings → n8n API → Create key. Add it as a Header Auth credential named `X-N8N-API-KEY`.

`GET /webhook/watchdog-status` returns the latest verdict.
